buckets.title: Local hybridisation, p-orbital geometry and delocalisation
buckets.badge_reason: The crux is coordinating atom-local sigma-framework labels with p-orbital orientation and translating localized Lewis contributors into one delocalised electronic description without conflating these model layers.

capabilities.action: Translate formal Lewis contributors into one qualitative delocalised pi description while preserving the invariant sigma framework.
capabilities.success_criterion: Separates invariant connectivity/sigma framework from contributor-local formal bond/charge placement and rejects temporal switching among contributors.

capabilities.action: Coordinate local sigma-framework assignments with the count and orientation of unhybridised p orbitals required by pi bonding.
capabilities.success_criterion: Uses p-orbital orientation to explain allene terminal-plane geometry, twisting effects, and continuous versus interrupted p pathways.

capabilities.action: Assign introductory hybridisation locally from sigma-bond directions/lone-pair domains and verify the assignment against required unhybridised p orbitals.
capabilities.success_criterion: Never assigns one label to a whole molecule and distinguishes multiple-bond components from local electron-domain count.

microtopics.badge_reason: The decisive move coordinates more than one representation or atomic centre rather than recalling a label.
entry_assumptions: Owner preset: local sp/sp2/sp3 counting, sigma/pi components and elementary p overlap are DEMONSTRATED; multi-centre/representation coordination is UNCERTAIN.
microtopics.inferential_jump: Separate the invariant sigma framework from contributor-local formal bond/charge placement, then build one delocalised pi model without turning resonance drawings into time states.

teaching_path.action: Compare all contributors and classify features as invariant or contributor-local.
teaching_path.why_valid: Translation must begin from meaning, not line-position copying.

teaching_path.action: Fix the common planar sigma skeleton.
teaching_path.why_valid: All contributors preserve the same connectivity and sigma directions.

teaching_path.action: Orient the relevant p orbitals perpendicular to the planar sigma framework.
teaching_path.why_valid: Side-on pi overlap uses an orbital direction distinct from the in-plane sigma framework.

teaching_path.action: Construct one delocalised pi description and translate back without switching language.
teaching_path.why_valid: The target representation must preserve the supplied equivalent positions and treat contributors as formal components.

misconceptions.wrong_idea: The ion rapidly switches among localized Lewis contributors.
misconceptions.diagnostic_prompt: Which atom positions or sigma bonds would physically change if switching were literal?
misconceptions.repair: Treat contributors as formal components; preserve one sigma framework and translate pi information into one delocalised description.

exit_task.prompt: Three formal contributors share one atomic skeleton. Which features survive into one orbital description?

answer.summary: Connectivity, overall charge/electron inventory and the sigma skeleton survive; formal localized double-bond/charge placement does not become a time-resolved state.
reasoning: Treat contributors as formal components; preserve one sigma framework and translate pi information into one delocalised description.

microtopics.title: Coordinate p-orbital directions across several centres
microtopics.badge_reason: The decisive move coordinates more than one representation or atomic centre rather than recalling a label.
entry_assumptions: Owner preset: local sp/sp2/sp3 counting, sigma/pi components and elementary p overlap are DEMONSTRATED; multi-centre/representation coordination is UNCERTAIN.
microtopics.inferential_jump: After local sigma-framework counting, use the number and direction of remaining unhybridised p orbitals as a consistency check on the three-dimensional pi system.

teaching_path.action: Assign local sigma frameworks atom by atom.
teaching_path.why_valid: Adjacent atoms can legitimately have different local models.

teaching_path.action: Inventory unhybridised p orbitals left at each relevant centre.
teaching_path.why_valid: Pi bonding uses orbitals not consumed by the local sigma framework.

teaching_path.action: Align neighboring p orbitals for every required pi overlap or continuous pathway.
teaching_path.why_valid: Side-on overlap requires compatible relative orientation and adjacency.

teaching_path.action: Infer the spatial consequence and test every required pi bond/pathway simultaneously.
teaching_path.why_valid: The orbital construction must satisfy all pi requirements at once.

misconceptions.wrong_idea: Flatten allene into an ethene-like plane or assume separated double bonds are automatically conjugated.
misconceptions.diagnostic_prompt: How many distinct central p orbitals are required in allene, or is there a p orbital on every bridge atom in the diene?
misconceptions.repair: Use local p-orbital inventory and orientation/adjacency checks before inferring geometry or conjugation.

exit_task.prompt: Allene needs two pi overlaps at its central carbon. What local sigma model and p-orbital arrangement can support both?

answer.summary: The central carbon is locally sp with two orthogonal unhybridised p orbitals; each overlaps with a terminal p orbital, producing perpendicular terminal CH2 planes.
reasoning: Use local p-orbital inventory and orientation/adjacency checks before inferring geometry or conjugation.
Check the conclusion against the local sigma framework and required p-orbital arrangement.

microtopics.title: A reliable atom-local hybridisation procedure
microtopics.badge_reason: The decisive move coordinates more than one representation or atomic centre rather than recalling a label.
entry_assumptions: Owner preset: local sp/sp2/sp3 counting, sigma/pi components and elementary p overlap are DEMONSTRATED; multi-centre/representation coordination is UNCERTAIN.
microtopics.inferential_jump: Treat hybridisation as an atom-local sigma-framework model, then verify that enough correctly oriented unhybridised p orbitals remain for the required pi system.

teaching_path.action: Choose one atom and list its local sigma-bond directions and lone-pair electron domains.
teaching_path.why_valid: A molecule can contain different local environments.

teaching_path.action: Count local domains; a multiple bond contributes one sigma direction.
teaching_path.why_valid: Electron-domain geometry follows sigma directions/lone-pair domains rather than total bond order.

teaching_path.action: Map the local count to the introductory sp/sp2/sp3 sigma-framework model.
teaching_path.why_valid: The label describes a local orbital model.

teaching_path.action: Check remaining p orbitals against all required pi bonds/delocalisation and their orientation.
teaching_path.why_valid: A label that cannot supply the required pi orbitals is internally inconsistent.

misconceptions.wrong_idea: Assign one hybridisation label to an entire molecule, infer sp2 from equivalent bonds, or count a triple bond as three local domains.
misconceptions.diagnostic_prompt: What are the separate domain counts at each nonequivalent atom, and do the resulting labels leave the required p orbitals?
misconceptions.repair: Assign locally from the sigma framework, then run an independent p-orbital count/orientation check.

exit_task.prompt: Apply the local procedure to propyne and allene. Does one label fit every carbon?

answer.summary: No. Propyne is locally sp3/sp/sp; allene is sp2/sp/sp2, and those assignments leave the p orbitals required by their pi bonds.
reasoning: Assign locally from the sigma framework, then run an independent p-orbital count/orientation check.
Check the conclusion against the local sigma framework and required p-orbital arrangement.
answer.check: The explanation must preserve the stated invariant and the model boundary.
